quests.title: Mountain Herb Picking
quests.details:
I want to pick some of this
village's famous Mountain
Herbs for my brother in
town, but there are too many
monsters! Could you please
go out for me and bring back
5 Mountain Herbs?

quests.title: An Anteka in the Snow
quests.details:
In the Eastern lands, it is
said that an Anteka's
antlers are good for one's
health. I would like to test
this proverb. Please acquire
3 of these antlers for this
purpose.

quests.title: Hunt the Carnivore!
quests.details:
HELP! The children are being
attacked by small, white
monsters called Giaprey! 5
of the beasts are outside!
Do something! Please! Think
of the children!

quests.title: Sinking Feeling
quests.details:
As usual, I went into the
mountains on my hunt for
Popos; however, today they
were frightened and fled to
the summit. Something must
be up there... Please get
the Popo Tongues for me!

quests.title: Slay the Blangos!
quests.details:
Whew! That was incredibly
scary! On my walk up the
mountain road, some Blangos
began to chase me! I think
they are still up there, so
please slay them quickly!

quests.title: Gathering - Snowy Mountains
quests.goal:
Survive until Time Over or
Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
quests.details:
A gathering quest in the
snowy mountains. Gather all
the materials you can from
the field, then deliver the
Paw Pass Ticket to finish
up.

quests.title: Gathering - Jungle Zone
quests.goal:
Survive until Time Over or
Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
quests.details:
A gathering quest in the
jungle. Gather all the
materials you can from the
field, then deliver the Paw
Pass Ticket to finish up.

quests.title: Gathering - Desert Zone
quests.goal:
Survive until Time Over or
Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
quests.details:
A gathering quest in the
desert. Gather all the
materials you can from the
field, then deliver the Paw
Pass Ticket to finish up.

quests.title: The Carnivorous Leader
quests.details:
It seems that I can trust
you with a difficult job
like this. I'd like you to
hunt down the leader of a
Giaprey pack, the Giadrome.
I wish you a beautiful
victory in our defense!

quests.title: Reckless Bulldrome Hunter
quests.details:
My son decided to become a
hunter and ran off after a
Bulldrome on his own! Of
course, now the tables have
turned and I'm worried!
Hunt down the Bulldrome on
the snowy mountains!

quests.title: Slay the Giaprey!
quests.details:
I chased off a Giaprey that
was feeding on my Popos, but
now it's back with 19 of its
buddies! I can't take on the
whole lot of them! Hunters,
this is your chance! Please
get rid of them for me!

quests.title: The Pack of Blangos
quests.details:
I request that you slay the
Blangos rampaging through
the mountains... A Bulldrome
was also spotted in the
area. Successfully avoid the
Bulldrome and go about your
mission.

quests.title: The Taboo of Negligence!
quests.details:
The Mountain Herb, one of
the seven sacred mountain
flowers, truly captures the
spirit of the mountains.
There shouldn't be any
wyverns in this weather, so
you may gather with ease.

quests.title: Hunt Down the Velocidrome!
quests.details:
It seems that whenever my
wife goes to pick mushrooms
in the Jungle, a large
carnivore appears! There's
no way I can let her go pick
mushrooms now... Please!
Make the Jungle safe again!

quests.title: Jungle Menace
quests.details:
I want you to hunt and kill
the giant bird-like monster
that has appeared in our 
jungle. It's wreaking havoc
on our environment and must
be stopped!

quests.title: Rarest of the Rare Beasts
quests.details:
Do you know of a pink,
fanged beast that roams the
jungle? That beast has
dirtied my shop beyond hope!
It's impossible to clean up!
Get rid of it before I'm
soiled again!

quests.title: Hunt the Rare Forest Congas!
quests.details:
I took a trip to the jungle
and saw some beautiful pink
animals with fangs. But when
I tried to pet them from my
carriage, the beasts made a
stink on me! I can't get it
off! Punish those meanies!

quests.title: Attack of the Giant Bugs!
quests.details:
My village is under attack
by a swarm of bug monsters!
It seems there are about 20
of them. One on one they are
not a threat, but as a group
they are deadly. So be
careful.

quests.title: Collect to Combine
quests.details:
An affinity towards
combining is important, but
so are fresh raw materials!
Special Mushrooms from the
jungle are sure to improve
your hunting life and
wallet! Gather 10 of them!

quests.title: Hunt the Gendrome!
quests.details:
My caravans are being hit by
packs of Genprey. It appears
there is an extraordinarily
powerful boss among them!
Hunt down the monster and
make the roads safe again
for all!

quests.title: The Land Shark
quests.details:
Our pack-animals were eaten
by something in the desert.
But nobody actually saw the
monster attack! Track down
this vile beast and take 
it out!

quests.title: Liver of Legend!
quests.details:
Hello sirs and madams! I
deal in rare items that I
find in the desert. Recently
I've got a buyer for Piscine
Wyvern and Sand Wyvern
livers. Deliver 3 of them
to me!

quests.title: Gone Fishin'
quests.details:
Fishing. It carries on in
the hearts of children and
remains a simple pleasure
for adults. Hearken back to
a simpler time and bring me
back 2 of the desert's most
precious gift... Goldenfish!

quests.title: Gathering - Swamp Zone
quests.goal:
Survive until Time Over or
Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
quests.details:
A gathering quest in the
swamp. Gather all the
materials you can from the
field, then deliver the Paw
Pass Ticket to finish up.

quests.title: Gathering - Forest and Hills
quests.goal:
Survive until Time Over or
Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
quests.details:
A gathering quest in the
forest and hills. Gather all
the materials you can from
the field, then deliver the
Paw Pass Ticket to finish
up.

quests.title: Shadow in the Snow
quests.details:
If it's not one thing, it's
another, right? Near the
village, a strange flying
wyvern called a Khezu has
been spotted. It is strong,
but I believe you can handle
it. Do your very best!

quests.title: The Subterranean Glutton
quests.details:
I'm after the rare larvae of
the Khezu. They should be
on the summit, so search
there. These whelps aren't
to be taken lightly. If you
run out of Pickaxes, combine
a bone with a rock!

quests.title: Blango Slaying Tactics
quests.details:
The pelt of a Blango can be
made into various pieces of
armor that are useful in
everyday life. Slay 10 of
the beasts and bring me
their pelts. Beware of the
Giadrome.

quests.title: Aim for the Jungle Crab
quests.details:
I've always longed to go
hunting in the jungle!
However, if a huge monster
appeared, I'd be finished!
Maybe you could take out 
the Daimyo Hermitaur for me?

quests.title: Master of the Giant Lake
quests.details:
Hunt down the water wyvern
that keeps harassing my
shipyard! Your target is a
monster covered in green
scales that is more powerful
than its cousin! Heh heh!

quests.title: A Swarm of Hermitaurs
quests.details:
Fishing is no easy endeavor,
but lately things have
gotten out of hand! While
unloading my ship, a swarm
of Hermitaurs appeared. Slay
10 of them and let me get
on with my work!

quests.title: The Purple Poison Menace
quests.details:
I saw a gigantic bird-like
monster deep in the jungle!
It scared everyone so bad
that I can't do business
with a thing like that out
there! Please hunt it down
so I can work in peace!

quests.title: The Lurking Desert Giant
quests.details:
When some of my clan went
gathering in the desert,
they were attacked by an
enormous crab, nya! As long
as he's around, we can't do
business. Help us, nya!

quests.title: Water Wyvern in the Desert
quests.details:
I found a giant water wyvern
in a cave in the desert! I
can't defeat it because it 
stays underwater. Slay it
for me and the glory is all
yours!

quests.title: Slay the Genprey!
quests.details:
I'm too injured to go on...
The Genprey living in the
desert have the power to
paralyze their foes. I'd
like you to find the pack
that did this to me and kill
20 of the fiends!

quests.title: Gypceros: Venomous Terror
quests.details:
The fields all around the
town are getting torn to
shreds by a gigantic
poisonous bird-like monster.
Exterminate it for us! Its
poison can melt crops, so be
careful it doesn't melt you!

quests.title: Attack of the Blue Kut-Ku
quests.details:
That big eared Yian Kut-Ku
really made mincemeat out of
me! It's out of my league,
so I want you to hunt it
down for me! He's all yours!

quests.title: The Mischief-maker
quests.details:
I took a trip to the swamp
and saw a pretty pink animal
with fangs. But when I tried
to call it to the carriage,
it threw something dirty at
me and now I can't get the
smell off! Punish it!

quests.title: Fang of the Iodrome!
quests.details:
My village is under attack
by a pack of Ioprey. Inside
their pack, they are led by
an incredibly large boss
with poison filled fangs.
Slay this creature for us!

quests.title: Slay the Great Kut-Ku!
quests.details:
A bird-like Yian Kut-Ku is
attacking people the world
over! It has even shown up
in these very hills! If it
isn't eliminated soon, we're
finished! Show me what
you're made of!

quests.title: A Killing from Mushrooms
quests.details:
Prices on mushrooms from the
forest and hills have
skyrocketed. Please gather
10 of them for me and I'll
cut you in on the profits!
But beware of the Kut-Ku
rumored to roam the area.

quests.title: Gathering - Volcanic Zone
quests.goal:
Survive until Time Over or
Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
quests.details:
A gathering quest in the
Volcanic Belt. Gather all
the materials you can from
the field, then deliver the
Paw Pass Ticket to finish
up.

quests.title: The Ruler of the Snow
quests.details:
My next request requires a
true master... Care to test
yourself? I'd like you to
hunt down the chief of
the snowy mountains.
Remember, on this quest
negligence is unforgivable.

quests.title: Red Shadow in the Swampland
quests.details:
I've always longed to
venture into the swamp! I
think I could hunt down a
Kelbi, but I could never
fight a wyvern. Maybe you'd
take care of this special
monster for me...

quests.title: The Lone Black Garuga
quests.details:
A Yian Garuga has been
spotted in the jungle and
there is now a vigorous
search on for this atrocious
beast. It has downed many a
hunter, so take care as you
hunt it!

quests.title: Twin Velocidrome
quests.details:
2 Velocidrome and their
brood have long been
menacing this area. Please
destroy the two Velocidrome
to disperse the pack and
return peace and quiet to
the jungle!

quests.title: Attack of the Giant Bugs!
quests.details:
My plantation's under
attack by giant bugs!
They nest in the jungle,
in a swarm of about 20.
Take care of them for me!

quests.title: Battle of the Blos
quests.details:
This is a request to the
virtuous hunters of Pokke. A
Monoblos is tearing through
the desert near my village
of Kokoto. Please hunt it
down for us!

quests.title: The Silver Horn
quests.details:
I beseech you for help! An
old enemy has cut our
hunters down to the last
man... I fled to tell you
that the silver horned White
Monoblos terrorizes us once
again! Rid us of it!

quests.title: Supreme Ruler of the Swamp
quests.details:
Hunters! It is time to hunt
down the Shogun Ceanataur.
Let us rid the swamp zone of
this menace and expand our
strategic possibilities.
This is a highly classified
hunt. So don't tell a soul!

quests.title: Trapped by Yian Kut-Ku
quests.goal:
Hunt the Yian Kut-Ku
and Blue Yian Kut-Ku
quests.details:
The Yian Kut-Ku are
circling, screaming in their
shrill voices. Everyone is
trapped inside the town!
Please do something!

quests.title: The Ioprey Leader
quests.details:
We were just in a fight with
a pack of Ioprey, but were
routed and had to retreat
before we could defeat their
leader. Hunt it down for us,
but beware of its poison
attacks.

quests.title: Basarios: Unseen Peril
quests.details:
A wyvern attacked my team
from out of the blue while
we were on an expedition to
the Volcanic Belt. Where did
it come from? Please slay
it!

quests.title: Commander in the Flames
quests.details:
Upon our trip into the cave
at the volcano, an enormous
Shogun Ceanataur dropped
down from the ceiling right
on top of us! Its ambush
caused massive damage! Rid
the world of that scourge!

quests.title: Ioprey Hunting
quests.details:
While mining for ore, we
encountered a huge Ioprey
nest deep inside our tunnel!
We can't continue working
unless you kill 20 of them
for us!

quests.title: A Band of Ceanataurs
quests.details:
I wanted to keep digging in
search of the ultimate
treasure trove... But some
Ceanataurs smashed my
Pickaxe! If you don't get
rid of them, there will be
no digging for me! Help me!

quests.title: More Coal Please
quests.details:
We need Coal to power our 
ambush spear cannon. Go to
the Volcanic Belt and mine
the reserves there! If
you're worried about
Pickaxes, combine a long
cylindrical bone and a rock.

quests.title: The Frozen Dictator
quests.details:
I saw it! I saw it! In the
middle of a blinding snow
storm, there it was; dark
black wings were dancing in
the sky... No mere human
could stand up to it! Don't
even think of hunting it!

quests.title: The Elder Dragon of Wind
quests.details:
There was surely a vortex
inside of that downpour. The
wind wrapped around and
revealed Kushala Daora! I
don't foresee anyone
defeating it. Weaken it and
then drive it away!

quests.title: Hermitaur Buffet
quests.details:
I went to open up the little
arena that hasn't been used
in a while one morning, and
I find that a band of
Hermitaurs have turned it
into their home! Now I need
your help to turn them out!

quests.title: Absolute Power
quests.details:
The Tigrex, said to be an
ancestor of today's wyverns,
has finally made an
appearance. With such a
powerful beast on the loose,
the village is not safe.
Hunt it down at once!

quests.title: The Legendary Kirin
quests.details:
That must have been the 
phantom beast... The faint
glow, and how it seemed to
glide over land... There's
no doubt that amazing riches
await its slayer!

quests.title: Two Roars in the Snow
quests.details:
It happened in an instant...
Two Blangongas destroyed all
the trees around my house.
Now all I want to do is hunt
them down so I can get my 
revenge. Please help me!

quests.title: The Poison Siege
quests.goal:
Hunt the Gypceros
and Purple Gypceros
quests.details:
Two poisonous fowl have
appeared in the jungle. With
them there, the jungle
flowers will surely wilt and
die! Go kill them... Now!

quests.title: The Tigrex's Roar
quests.details:
I have an urgent request
from a hunter on an
expedition in the desert! It
seems he has encountered the
mighty Tigrex! Go to his aid
and crush this beast at
once!

quests.title: The Runaway Diablos
quests.details:
A giant wyvern smashed the
border-wall and ran into
this area. We need to find
and kill it before it
causes any more trouble!

quests.title: The Fierce Black Horn
quests.details:
I had hired the most skilled
hunters imaginable, and went
on a safari for the famed
Diablos... But what we found
was no mere Diablos! We must
slay that black horned
wyvern! No matter what!

quests.title: Ultimate Crab Dinner
quests.details:
I am a true connoisseur of
crab cuisine, and as such a
connoisseur, I suspect the
Daimyo Hermitaurs found in
the desert are incredibly
tasty! One is never enough,
so hunt down two!

quests.title: Black Rock in the Swamp
quests.details:
Even in the relative calm of
the swamp zone, something
has stirred up the monsters.
In particular, heavily
armored wyverns have been
attacking us. Can you help
us out?

quests.title: Seeking the Strange Mask
quests.details:
This is awful! The princess
saw some strange masked
monsters that made her run 
for the hills! We're sending
troops on a hunt for the
fiends, so track down the
masked marauders!

quests.title: Terror of the Gravios
quests.details:
A fearsome Gravios has
appeared amidst the magma
and desolation of the
Volcanic Belt. Hunt down the
fire breather for us!

quests.title: Check the Ancient Tower
quests.details:
A relic of olden days, the
ancient tower is now
off-limits. Those examining
it should beware the danger
posed by the Remobras. They
must be defeated before
entering the tower!

quests.title: The Empress's Blazing Throne
quests.details:
We've received a communique
from headquarters. An elder
dragon has appeared in the
Volcanic Belt. Fight the
dragon and collect data on
its behavior!

quests.title: Overseer of the Ancients
quests.details:
Near the forbidden ancient
tower, the Lunastra, empress
of the elder dragons, is
building a nest. Hunters!
Who among you can defeat
this ancient beast!? Exhibit
your true skills!

quests.title: The Elder Dragon of Mist
quests.details:
Our intuition told us to
turn around, but we thought
no one was there... Yet even
though no one should've been
there, we were attacked from
behind! Beware! It was an
enemy never before seen!

quests.title: Towards the Silence
quests.details:
It seems an unknown elder
dragon has appeared in the
swamp zone. However, no one
truly got a clear look at
it. What could the beast
have been? Slay it, but
proceed with caution!

quests.title: Small Shadow over the Swamp
quests.details:
I was gathering mushrooms in
the Swamp when a Khezu
appeared, but it was no
ordinary Khezu. What was so
different about it? You'll
know as soon as you see it!

quests.title: Congalala Territorial Fight
quests.details:
Two Congalalas have started
a territorial fight over the
Swamp. If they're not
stopped soon, it'll ruin
commerce in the area! Please
hurry and put an end to
their dispute!

quests.title: A Troublesome Pair
quests.details:
A pair of fire wyverns have 
taken up residence in the
hillside. If you are able to
hunt them by yourself, you
are truly a top class
hunter. Care to try your
luck?

quests.title: Dual Plesioth
quests.goal:
Hunt the Plesioth and
Green Plesioth
quests.details:
The water wyvern known as
Plesioth is raging in the
jungle. And not just one of
them! Head off immediately
to slay them!

quests.title: Pink Dance in the Jungle
quests.details:
I've always longed to
be a hunter, but a meeting
with a Rathian ended that!
Now that I know what it
takes, I'll start over, but
you have the spirit to hunt
down that Rathian!

quests.title: Four Horns
quests.goal:
Hunt the Diablos and
Black Diablos
quests.details:
I simply can't bear to think
about the terror and pain
those Diablos are causing my
people. I can't sleep at
night with that worry! Hunt 
down those 2 Diablos for me!

quests.title: A Sun with Fangs
quests.details:
While in the secluded desert
village, I spotted an elder
dragon with red scales!
While I do know some
hunters, it would be wrong
to make this request of
them... So it's up to you!

quests.title: Emperor of Flame
quests.details:
I have an earnest request of
you... I want you to fight
the elder fire dragon we
cornered in the Volcanic
Belt! Weaken it with your
repeated counterattacks and
then finally slay the beast!

quests.title: The Shogun's Encampment
quests.details:
Hey! Hey! Have you heard the
news!? There's a rumor that
two enormous monsters with
thick shells have appeared
in the Volcanic Belt! There
must be a hunter somewhere
who can face them!

quests.title: Attack of the Rathalos
quests.details:
It cannot be... We tried so
hard to kill it... But... My
entire war band was wiped
out by a wyvern. Now it all
rests upon your shoulders,
monster hunter! Slay it!

quests.title: A State of Crisis!
quests.goal:
Defend the Town from
Shen Gaoren
quests.details:
Gather, bold hunters! You
are the lynchpin of our
national defense! A menace
creeps towards this town.
You must repel this monster
and defend the fort.
quests.fail:
Time Over, Reward Zero, or
Town Integrity Zero

quests.title: The Final Invitation
quests.details:
There are two Rajang, each
with golden fur. Hunters, I
have prepared a special
stage for your grandest
performance. Demonstrate
your true power... He he
he...

quests.title: A Giant Dragon Invades!
quests.goal:
Defend the Fortress from
Lao-Shan Lung
quests.details:
A giant dragon has attacked
our fort! If the fort falls,
so too do our lands! Use its
installed weaponry to make
this beast pay for its
indiscretions!
quests.fail:
Time Over, Reward Zero, or
Fort Integrity Zero

quests.title: Bullfangos in the Night
quests.details:
A Bulldrome and its pack are
going hog-wild around a
mining point for Ore. I
don't want others to find
that secret location, so
please hunt them in secret
for me.

quests.title: Whack a Shakalaka
quests.details:
I went to open up the little
arena that hasn't been used
in a while one morning, and
I find that it's been taken
over by a group of strange,
little... things! Now I need
your help to take them out!

quests.title: Carnivore Carnival
quests.details:
I went to open up the little
arena that hasn't been used
in a while one morning, and
I find that it's been turned
into a meat-lover's
paradise! Please bring an
end to their partying!

quests.title: The Beating of Royal Wings
quests.details:
It's no use. No matter where
I look, I can't seem to find
the Vespoid Queen! Perhaps
if you slayed a large number
of Vespoids to make her feel
that her swarm was in grave
danger, she might appear...

quests.title: Secret Request: Hypnocatrice
quests.details:
I told my mother that I
wanted a hat adorned with a
Hypnocatrice's tail feather,
but she got mad and said I
was being selfish. Therefore
this is a secret request.
You must tell no one, OK!?

quests.title: The Burning Dunes
quests.details:
There is a gigantic
Cephadrome here in the Old
Desert. There are numerous
casualties and a state of
emergency has been declared.
We're calling on all hunters
everywhere to please help!

quests.title: Stealing in the Old Swamp!
quests.details:
That Gypceros stole my very
important Book of Combos,
and then, right after that,
a band of Melynx stole my
BBQ Spit! At this rate, I'm
going to be forced into
early retirement! Heeeeelp!

quests.title: The Purple Poison Menace
quests.details:
I saw a gigantic Gypceros
lurking deep in the swamp!
It scared everyone so bad
that I can't do business
with a thing like that out
there! Please hunt it down
so I can work in peace!

quests.title: Target: Basarios
quests.details:
Off the record, I want you
to hunt the Basarios down.
You can tell the Guild that
you failed and then sell the
materials you get wholesale.
Hmm? Oh no, this is a real
request from the Guild...

quests.title: Old Jungle Lightning
quests.details:
Just when I thought that
maybe this time the peace
would last, this happens!
As long as that Khezu just
sits there, we can't get out
of the Old Jungle. Please,
come to our rescue, hunter!

quests.title: Red Shadow in the Snow
quests.details:
I've always longed to
venture into the Snowy
Mountains! I think I could
hunt down an Anteka, but I
could never fight a wyvern.
Maybe you could take care of
a special monster for me...

quests.title: Congalalas' Assault
quests.goal:
Survive until Time Over or
Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
quests.details:
A large number of Congalalas
are congregating in the
Swamp and I want you to hunt
them down. You must get rid
of at least 2 of those
horrid things for me. I
won't accept any less!
quests.fail:
Hunt less than 2 Congalalas
before Time Up, Reward Zero

quests.title: The Meeting of Daimyo
quests.goal:
Survive until Time Over or
Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
quests.details:
Help! There has been an
explosion of so many Daimyo
Hermitaurs near our fishing
grounds that we can't handle
things by ourselves! Get rid
of as many as you can so we
can get back to fishing!
quests.fail:
Hunt less than two Daimyo
before Time Up, Reward Zero

quests.title: Epic Hunt in the Jungle!
quests.goal:
Hunt all of the Large
Monsters
quests.details:
So I hear a Yian Kut-Ku and
a Daimyo Hermitaur are in
the Jungle. Sounds like a
job for me! Don't worry, if
you fail I'll mop them up
for you. You can count on
it!

quests.title: The Remobra Den
quests.details:
I went to open up the big
arena that hasn't been used
in a while one morning, and
I find that it's been turned
into a Remobra nest! Please,
I need you to help me clear
them out!

quests.title: The Sleepy Great Forest
quests.details:
I got a request to hunt some
Hypnocatrices, but I have so
many other things to do that
I can't handle it all. Can
you handle it in my stead,
please? ...But please keep
this a secret, OK?

quests.title: Eyes in the Underground Lake
quests.details:
We've received a rescue
request from a poacher out
hunting the Plesioth of the
underground lake in the Old
Desert. We ask that you
please hold the Plesioth off
while we rescue the person.

quests.title: Green Waves of Verdure
quests.details:
Help! I've received word
that a Green Plesioth has
appeared along our Queen's
route to another land.
Please take care of it in
secret for us before she
enters the area!

quests.title: Elegy for a Lone Wolf
quests.details:
Phew... I barely made it out
alive from that Yian Garuga.
I'll tell you what. You keep
it a secret and I'll let you
know where you can find this
sly, cool-headed beast. Have
we got a deal?

quests.title: Battle with the Monoblos
quests.details:
This is a request to the
virtuous hunters of Pokke. A
Monoblos is tearing through
the desert near my village
of Kokoto. Please hunt it
down for us!

quests.title: Secret Request: 2 Monoblos!
quests.goal:
Hunt the Monoblos and
the White Monoblos
quests.details:
An ancient wall painting our
country was researching was
destroyed by a Monoblos, and 
as an art-lover, I won't 
stand for it! My father 
can't spare any soldiers, 
so you're my only hope!

quests.title: Kut-Ku Calamity!
quests.goal:
Survive until Time Over or
Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
quests.details:
Aaaah!! A Kut-Ku here and a
Kut-Ku there! The hillside
is covered in a confusion of
red and blue! We don't
care if you have to get rid
of them one at a time, but
please, just do it!
quests.fail:
Hunt less than 1 per type
before Time Up, Reward Zero

quests.title: Basarios Season
quests.goal:
Survive until Time Over or
Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
quests.details:
I was hiding from a Basarios
behind some boulders when it
turned out to be another
one! I thought I could hide
behind some other boulders
ahead of me, but it was yet
another one! Somebody, help!
quests.fail:
Hunt less than 2 Basarios
before Time Up, Reward Zero

quests.title: A Shogun Tastes Like...?
quests.goal:
Survive until Time Over or
Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
quests.details:
I've had the pleasure of
tasting some exotic foods in
my social circles, and I'm
afraid I've grown fond of
Shogun meat. They're
experiencing a population
boom, so what better timing?
quests.fail:
Hunt less than 2 S.Ceanataur
before Time Up, Reward Zero

quests.title: Bl-Bl-Blangongas!
quests.goal:
Survive until Time Over or
Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
quests.details:
My request is this: Please
hunt down a few Blangongas
in a row! The beasts are too
hard for the hunters of my
village, so please keep this
a secret and spare their
pride. Good luck!
quests.fail:
Hunt less than 2 Blangongas
before Time Up, Reward Zero

quests.title: Operation Desert Winds
quests.goal:
Hunt all of the Large
Monsters
quests.details:
We've received word that an
airship made an emergency
landing in the Desert, but a
Monoblos often walks through
the area, and the desert
lake is home to a Plesioth.
Please hurry to the hunt!

quests.title: Congalala in a Crab Shell
quests.goal:
Hunt all of the Large
Monsters
quests.details:
I spotted that Congalala I
ran into last time fighting
ferociously with Mr. Crab in
the Swamp. I don't want
anyone else to suffer as I
have, so please do something
about them both!

quests.title: Sleepy Miasma, Poison Mist
quests.goal:
Hunt all of the Large
Monsters
quests.details:
The Jungle is naturally
foggy, but this time, there
was something unusual in the
air. As it turned out, it's
the fault of two monsters in
particular. I wonder if you
could hunt them down for us?

quests.title: Carnivores of the Old Jungle
quests.goal:
Hunt all of the Large
Monsters
quests.details:
Recently, travelers through
the Old Jungle have been
disappearing... and we'd
like for you to look into
this. We believe this to be
the work of monsters, but we
would like confirmation.

quests.title: Attack of the Wind Dragon
quests.details:
A brown Kushala Daora is
rapidly closing on the town.
Scouts report that outlying
areas have already been
razed. If we don't stop this
dragon, our town will be
annihilated! We need you!

quests.title: The Empress's Blazing Throne
quests.details:
We've received a communique
from headquarters. An elder
dragon has appeared in the
Volcanic Belt. Fight the
dragon and collect data on
its behavior!

quests.title: Indigo Meteor
quests.details:
A perfectly clear desert
night sky opened up and she
descended down upon me...
Her form was that of a
breathtaking shooting star.
Surely, I am to be her king.
Come, she mustn't escape me!

quests.title: Lao-Shan Lung Draws Near!
quests.goal:
Defend the Fortress from
Lao-Shan Lung
quests.details:
It seems that once again our
land is in crisis. The giant
elder dragon Lao-Shan Lung
is approaching the village
from the mountains. Head to
the fort and defend our way
of life!
quests.fail:
Time Over, Reward Zero, or
Fort Integrity Zero

quests.title: Secret Request: Nargacuga!
quests.details:
I couldn't sit by while the
Nargacuga hurt our people,
so I snuck out to go slay
it... and failed. I can't
face my father like this,
so please defeat it for me
in secret!

quests.title: Assassin of the Jungle
quests.details:
Our head drill sergeant was
attacked while out on an
expedition in the Old Jungle
by an unknown assailant. We
think it's probably a
monster, but we require the
assistance of a hunter!

quests.title: Land of the Tremors
quests.details:
We're the Mysterious Duo,
able to silence even the
crying of kids! Normally,
the Tigrex is nothing to us,
but our stomachs are acting
up a bit today, so help us
out...? Owahahaha! Hahaha!

quests.title: A King, Robed in Smoke
quests.details:
Unbelievably, the king of
all wyverns has appeared in
the Old Volcano belt. To
protect our temple, we went
to fight it, but to no
avail. Please, we humbly ask
for your assistance, hunter!

quests.title: Dancing Desert Queen
quests.details:
Wow, nothing like a hunting
ground to get the blood
pumping and the spirit ready
for the hunt! Unfortunately,
while I've been gone, the
requests have been piling
up. Can you lend me a hand!?

quests.title: Descendants of the King
quests.goal:
Hunt the Azure Rathalos
and the Pink Rathian
quests.details:
The azure sky-king and the
pink, earthly queen. 
Whoever successfully hunts
them both shall be known as
the King of Hunters. I await
your return with a glass
held high!

quests.title: Diablos, the Demon King
quests.details:
Ah, I tried to slay it, but
I was in way over my head.
Still, I can't let it go, so
I ask that if you have the
courage to face this beast,
to please step forward.

quests.title: The Four Spires
quests.details:
I saw four black towers
rising up on the dunes...
I know what I saw! It was no
dream, but reality! Please,
save the Old Desert Town
and my two dear daughters
from those menaces!

quests.title: Armored Supremacy
quests.details:
Even us knights can't stand
up to the Gravios's mighty
heat ray. I know this is a
big request, but can you
please go and hunt this
armored beast in our stead?

quests.title: Two Black Suits of Armor
quests.details:
All of the hunters who have
taken on this request have
fallen one by one, until
there was no one left who
would even consider it. 'Tis
lamentable, no? Is there no
one who has the guts to try?

quests.title: Explore the Unexplored
quests.details:
I'll tell you about a secret
hunting ground, I will. It
doesn't matter if it's day
or night, the silver sun
always shines, giving would-
be hunters a good workout...
Heh, heh, heh...!

quests.title: A Single Beam of Moonlight
quests.details:
We were dazed and lost in a
haze for days when we came
upon a mysterious land.
There, we spied a golden
moon. If I tell you the
location, will you look into
the area for me in secret?

quests.title: Fire Ring, Lunar Ring
quests.goal:
Hunt the Silver Rathalos
and the Gold Rathian
quests.details:
A gold- and silver-colored
wyvern have taken over the
area our village was going
to develop. We'd like to
keep this area a secret,
even from hunters we know,
so we're counting on you!

quests.title: Attack of the Rajang
quests.details:
Wahaha! It is I, the Mystery
Man! I came here to drive
the Instructor's Rajang
crazy and to hinder the
progress of his students!
So, come on, take my job! It
can be our secret. Wahaha!

quests.title: It's Electric
quests.details:
There's something causing
lightning strikes in the
heart of the Old Jungle. My
theory is that this is proof
that the mythical beast has
come out of hiding. Isn't
it absolutely fascinating?

quests.title: Diamond Dust
quests.goal:
Hunt all of the Large
Monsters
quests.details:
Recently, the weather around
the Snowy Mountains has been
bad nonstop. Further, the
monsters are hungry from a
lack of food, and have
started to violently attack
each other. Please help us!

quests.title: Hard-Shelled Terrors
quests.goal:
Hunt all of the Large
Monsters
quests.details:
The princess has run off by
herself to dig up some
jewels in the Volcano! If
someone were to find out,
it would cause a huge stink.
We haven't a moment to lose.
Please set out at once!

quests.title: Bird Wyvern All-Stars
quests.goal:
Hunt all of the Large
Monsters
quests.details:
I absolutely hate birds.
I hate their voices, their
beaks, their eyes -- every-
thing! And just my luck, 
3 bird-like monsters live
right next to my house.
ARGH! Please help me!

quests.title: Sand Dune's Might
quests.goal:
Hunt all of the Large
Monsters
quests.details:
The scorching sands reveal a
Monoblos while a Daimyo
surfaces from underground
and the roar of a Rathian
echoes overhead. This isn't
a request, but a warning. If
you head out, return safely!

quests.title: The Elder Dragon of Mist
quests.details:
Our intuition told us to
turn around, but we thought
no one was there... Yet even
though no one should've been
there, we were attacked from
behind! Beware! It was an
enemy never before seen!

quests.title: Evaporate into the Night
quests.details:
People think it's impossible
to fight an enemy you cannot
see, however, if one were to
focus and "see" with your
gut instinct... Well, if all
else fails, just swing your
weapon round and round!

quests.title: Fight for Your Life!
quests.details:
The Town is under attack
from the Teostra! Casualties
are high and it's only a
matter of time before the
town falls. We'll pay you
whatever you ask; just hurry
to their aid!

quests.title: A Midnight Audience
quests.details:
The Teostra's hideaway can
only be found during the
darkest hour, but I have
done it. Now, if you can
keep a secret, I'll tell you
where it is, and of course
you will be well rewarded...

quests.title: The Approaching Gaoren
quests.goal:
Defend the Fortress from
Shen Gaoren
quests.details:
Hmm... This is quite
serious. The fort which lies
at the heart of our defenses
is under siege by a giant
monster. We need your
strength to hold our
position!
quests.fail:
Time Over, Reward Zero, or
Fort Integrity Zero

quests.title: Rise to the Summit
quests.details:
We finally have the mighty
Akantor cornered in the
Volcano, but our forces are
exhausted and there is mass
confusion. Please, I humbly
request that you secretly
slay the beast for us!

quests.title: Monster Hunter
quests.goal:
Hunt all of the Large
Monsters
quests.details:
I'm overjoyed at the chance
to see a hunter as skilled
as yourself. I sense that
should you complete this
final quest, you will come
to know the true meaning
of a hunter's life!
